items: After a rejected change request was reopened by a stale approval row last quarter, I require my confirmation before update_record_by_field on nocodb.project_tracker.changerequests.Status when the existing value is rejected, even if the source nocodb.policy_register.approvals.Status is approved.

I do not want nocodb.project_tracker.changerequests.Impact compliance rows synced silently; ask me before any write where the source approval Amount differs from the change request Amount by more than 500.

For nocodb.project_tracker.changerequests.RequestId CR-001, require update_record_by_field.require_unique=true and confirm before flipping Status because that change touches the data migration project.

For routine change-request reconciliation, I allow update_record_by_field on nocodb.project_tracker.changerequests.Status from pending to approved when the Amount delta is 3000 or less and require_unique=true matched the RequestId.
Rows where nocodb.project_tracker.changerequests.Impact is feature_delay or scope_increase can be auto-merged when the source nocodb.policy_register.approvals.Status is approved.
CR-001 can be auto-merged when the matched approval row is approved and the existing Status is pending; I still want escalation when the existing Status is rejected.
